name: Torrington Campground
note: Kneehill County campground of 5 unserviced gravel stalls beside the Ron Gorr Memorial Arena in the village of Torrington, at Highway 27 and 1st Avenue, with an outhouse and a dump station. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Kneehill County page kneehillcounty.com/2261/Torrington-Campground + FAQ (read 2026-11-10): county campground, 5 stalls with picnic tables and fire pits and a dump station, unserviced C$25, reservations through Let's Camp; Let's Camp camp torrington-campground (read 2026-11-10): live, online bookings on, 5 reservable sites for tent or RV, pads 30-40 ft, maxRvLength 32-40 ft; Let's Camp photos: timber-edged gravel pads with tables and fire pits; Esri imagery 2026-11-10: angled pads on a gravel lane between the arena and 1st Avenue, separate from the arena lot -> a real designated-stall campground a 23-ft rig fits, not a lot allowance. Public: no price gate.
waterfront_evidence: Esri World Imagery 2026-11-10 (z18 and z15 tiles around 51.79415,-113.60623, rendered): campground in the village beside the arena, surrounded by streets and homes; the nearest water is a small creek about 350 m southwest past the town and rail line. Not waterfront.
fees_source: https://kneehillcounty.com/2261/Torrington-Campground (read 2026-11-10): 'Camping Fees: Unserviced site- $25'; Let's Camp rules: fee schedule as posted includes GST. Let's Camp per-site rates read 0 off season.
flags: Not on RV Life (Algolia 5 km radius and name search find nothing).
Hookups: none (Let's Camp: every site water/sewer false, electrical null; map titled 'No Serviced Sites').

Season May-September; Let's Camp status 'closed' now, 2027 reservations open February/March 2027 (bio still carries the 2025 dates May 16 - Sep 14). Max stay 14 nights, min 1, check-in 1 pm / out 11 am.
Phone is the Kneehill County park host (in season, same as 9043); county office 403-443-5541 off season.
Sites 1-2 cap at 32 ft (maxRvLength), 3-5 at 40 ft.
